messages:
Lea (Product): Thanks for the Q&A today. Three quick clarifications teams asked for: 1) investment bias between Hosted/Dedicated/Private for the coming year, 2) a short sales sentence for Dedicated, 3) a clean positioning line vs cloud AI platforms and self-hosted runtimes.

Jordan (CEO): Short version: keep mission steady  make inference predictable & economical. Investment tilt: Hosted = primary growth engine (PLG + velocity), Dedicated = prioritized for enterprise monetization and SLAs, Private = targeted for regulated/strategic customers. We'll fund all three but shift incremental headcount to Hosted.

Ibrahim (Eng): Does "shift to Hosted" mean we slow Dedicated infra improvements? Need clarity for sprint planning.

Jordan (CEO): No freeze. Continue Dedicated stability/SLA workstreams. New feature cadence will be staggered so Hosted gets faster iteration.

Sam (RevOps): Sales signal for Dedicated? Spend threshold or usage pattern?

Jordan (CEO): Use a working threshold: sustained spend > $30k/month OR repeated peak QPS beyond shared pool SLOs, or explicit security/compliance ask. RevOps to finalize concrete numbers.

Lea (Product): Positioning vs competitors  be factual, not combative. What's the one-liner?

Jordan (CEO): "Redwood provides a unified, high-performance inference runtime across hosted, reserved, and private deployments, giving teams predictable latency, transparent unit economics, and enterprise controls without rebuilding their stack." Use that; adapt tone for devs vs execs.

Ibrahim (Eng): Actionable asks for Eng: list 3 SLO targets (p50/p95 latency, cold-start, cost/token) we should commit to for Hosted parity. I'll draft and post by Tue.

Lea (Product): Action items: I'll update roadmap to reflect Hosted-first tilt and add Dedicated milestones. Sam, please update the sales playbook with the two-liner and the $30k working threshold. Jordan, want to loop RevOps for final thresholds?

Jordan (CEO): Yep, loop RevOps. Thanks everyone.
